pages.text: The $(d)Anti-Field Orb$() allows you to $(9)temporarily disable certain Genes$().$(br2)Specifically, it disables the $(l:geneticsresequenced:genes/item_attraction_field)Item Attraction Field$(/l) and $(l:geneticsresequenced:genes/xp_attraction_field)XP Attraction Field$(/l) when enabled.$(br2)The $(l:geneticsresequenced:blocks/anti_field_block)Anti-Field Block$(/l) functions similarly, but in block form.
The Anti-Field Orb can be toggled by right-clicking it while held.
